references.text: Ajalon is mentioned here as part of Dan's inheritance, which aligns with the city being given to the Levites from the tribe of Dan.
Gath-Rimmon is mentioned as a city in Dan's territory, confirming that this city was transferred from Dan to the Levites.
This text in 1 Chronicles refers to the cities of the Levites and their pasturelands, including cities from the tribe of Dan.
Ajalon is mentioned here in connection with the Amorites who pressed against the tribe of Dan, showing the historical significance of the city.
The Valley of Ajalon is mentioned in connection with Joshua's victory over the Amorites, where the sun and moon stood still.
